question.text: Swachh Bharat Mission is one of NITI Aayog's 41 policy priorities. Which set of SDGs does the chapter associate with this mission?

answer.text: SDGs 1, 6, 11 (No Poverty, Clean Water & Sanitation, Sustainable Cities)
SDGs 4, 5, 8 (Quality Education, Gender Equality, Decent Work)
SDGs 13, 14, 15 (Climate, Life Below Water, Life on Land)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Table 1.5, Swachh Bharat Mission is linked to SDGs 1 (No Poverty), 6 (Clean Water & Sanitation) and 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities). Sanitation is the core SDG 6 linkage. **The Trap:** Option B covers education/gender/work — different policy verticals. Option C covers environmental SDGs only. Option D covers institution/partnership SDGs. **Cross-Exam Context:** Cross-links to Ch 8 (Case Studies — Swachh Bharat interventions). SIAs evaluating SE programmes operating in sanitation should cite this SDG triad in the AIR. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** When the SE's programme operates parallel to Swachh Bharat, test attribution carefully: the government scheme is a substantial co-contributor, so your counterfactual must adjust for deadweight. SAS-500 / SAS-1100 standards guide this assumption-testing.
